Messages.Author: Shane Travis
Messages.Body:
Eric G. Knight (unge...@scilab.uct.ac.za) wrote:
: Can you equip allies , if so when a vampires kills an allies does he get
: to take the equipment or is it burned ....

Allies cannot be equipped; only minions and Vampires may carry/weild
equipment.

Also, note that a vampire does not get to take equipment from any minion that
he kills (said equipment goes to its owner's ash heap) nor from any vampire
it burns in combat. Equipment transferring is a property of diablerie only.

: Does a wolf retainer do 1 damage no matter what the range....

Wolf Companion does its damage at close range only. The Rare card Murder
of Crows is identical in every way, except that it deals damage at both
short and long ranges.

Messages.Author: Joseph Cochran
Messages.Body:
In article <3nqvle$q...@tribune.usask.ca>,

Shane Travis <tra...@duke.usask.ca> wrote:
>Eric G. Knight (unge...@scilab.uct.ac.za) wrote:

>: Can you equip allies , if so when a vampires kills an allies does he get

>: to take the equipment or is it burned ....
>

>Allies cannot be equipped; only minions and Vampires may carry/weild
>equipment.

Er, I think Shane meant that *retainers* cannot equip. Allies
and vampires both count as minions, and minions can equip, so allies can
equip. The only way equipment transfers is if you grab it from one of
your other minions as an action, steal it in combat, or diaberize.
Since allies can't be diablerized, that leaves stealing it in combat if
you don't control that ally.
